# keycard_group (Resource)

Manages a Keycard group. A group is a zone-scoped collection of users that can be assigned roles and referenced in policies. Roles assigned to a group are inherited by its members.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A group with an identifier derived from the name
resource "keycard_group" "engineering" {
  zone_id = keycard_zone.production.id
  name    = "Engineering"
}

# A group with an explicit identifier, useful when policies or external systems
# reference the group by a stable name
resource "keycard_group" "oncall" {
  zone_id    = keycard_zone.production.id
  name       = "On-Call Engineers"
  identifier = "oncall-engineers"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable name for the group.
- `zone_id` (String) The zone this group belongs to. Changing this will replace the group.

### Optional

- `identifier` (String) User-specified identifier for the group, unique within the zone. Derived from the name when not set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# Groups can be imported using the format: zones/{zone-id}/groups/{group-id}
import {
  to = keycard_group.example
  id = "zones/zone-id-123/groups/group-id-456"
}

resource "keycard_group" "example" {
  # Configuration will be populated after import
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Groups can be imported using the format: zones/{zone-id}/groups/{group-id}
terraform import keycard_group.example zones/zone-id-123/groups/group-id-456
```
